chapters.title: The Beginning
chapters.subtitle: A vision during uncertainty
chapters.body: During a period when organizations were rethinking how they operated, collaborated and delivered value, Vanessa Ross established a vision for a consulting business that could connect business strategy with effective technology execution.

chapters.title: The Foundation
chapters.subtitle: Turning vision into capability
chapters.body: The early work centered on building practical delivery capability and earning trust one engagement at a time. Founder-confirmed details of early challenges, first clients and lessons learned will be added here.

chapters.title: The Growth
chapters.subtitle: Building relationships and delivering value
chapters.body: The firm developed its consulting capabilities, built trusted relationships and expanded its ambition to serve clients across the United States and South Africa. The actual sequence of milestones will be confirmed with the founder.

chapters.title: The Next Chapter
chapters.subtitle: AI, applications and global opportunity
chapters.body: E Worldwide Consulting is focused on production-ready AI agents, application engineering, intelligent automation, cloud transformation and international collaboration.
